usedFor: Ready Recall.ai recordings are uploaded to a Dropbox folder.

bestTemplate.name: “New Recording Becomes Ready” in Recall.ai, then “Upload File to Dropbox” in Dropbox
bestTemplate.why: The trigger fires once the recording's media is available, which is what an upload needs.

watchOut: “Upload File to Dropbox” pulls from a public web link, so the recording must be reachable at one.
